item.title: LONG READ: In Sweden, there are only good, bad, ugly and evil immigrants
item.description: Drawing on his own experiences, Faisal Khan examines how Swedish society sorts immigrants into four familiar stereotypes — the good, the bad, the ugly and the evil immigrant. The solution, he argues, is for Swedes and immigrants to meet more often.

item.title: What do you legally need to carry in your car in Sweden?
item.description: Whether you’re driving in Sweden as a resident or a tourist, it’s worth knowing what you legally need to have with you when you’re out on the roads.

item.title: Sweden’s 480 days of parental leave: What you need to know
item.description: Sweden's parental leave policy is generous enough to have earned media coverage around the world, and for many families it's a factor in choosing to live in the Nordic nation. But the specific terms, and the process for applying for benefits, can be tough to get to grips with.

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Monday
item.description: Swedish krona continues to strengthen against dollar, yellow weather warnings in Norrland and skiing holidays 'are almost a class issue'. Here's Sweden's news on Monday.

item.title: The Swedish origins of the Christmas song Fairytale of New York
item.description: The Pogues' Fairytale of New York, the gritty tale of love gone wrong many consider the greatest Christmas song ever written, has its origins in Sweden, at least according to a new commemorative plaque erected in the city of Malmö.

item.title: MAP: The local tax you will have to pay in Sweden in 2026
item.description: Residents of 16 Swedish municipalities will pay more local tax in 2026, while 45 municipalities will pay less tax. What's the situation where you live?

item.title: What a strong Swedish krona means for foreigners in Sweden
item.description: The Swedish krona has grown in value over the past year against major currencies like the dollar and the euro, and has been the best-performing currency among G10 countries for much of 2025. What does that mean for foreigners in Sweden?

item.title: How strong will the Swedish krona be in 2026?
item.description: The Swedish krona is the best-performing currency among the G10 countries, which are together the most traded currencies globally. But how well is it set to perform in 2026?

item.title: Swedish word of the day: stålar
item.description: Simply put, stålar is a Swedish slang word for money. However, it has its roots in a secret language made up by walking salesmen in western Sweden around the 1800s.

item.title: What’s changing for international train travel from Sweden in 2026?
item.description: The big news for international train travel from Sweden next year is the decision of state-owned rail company SJ to end its EuroNight overnight service between Stockholm and Berlin, but there are signs others may be coming in to fill the gap.
